name: rotation-saves
note: The boot's save fails (a full card): plays.1.jnl (1-4) is covered by no MARK. The next play rotates; the save runs first and lands (MARK 8). The next boot folds what the log still holds above MARK: 9; none lost.

name: rotation-fails
note: The boot's save fails (a full card): plays.1.jnl (1-4) is covered by no MARK. The next play rotates; the save runs first and fails too. The next boot folds what the log still holds above MARK: 5-9; 1-4 are lost to the stats (5.5's undercount, 4).

name: rotation-twin-saves
note: The boot's save fails (a full card): plays.1.jnl (1-4) is covered by no MARK. The next play rotates over a plays.1.jnl a twin's chain holds (renamed to a twin, not deleted); the save runs first and lands (MARK 8). The next boot folds what the log still holds above MARK: 9; none lost.

name: rotation-twin-fails
note: The boot's save fails (a full card): plays.1.jnl (1-4) is covered by no MARK. The next play rotates over a plays.1.jnl a twin's chain holds (renamed to a twin, not deleted); the save runs first and fails too. The next boot folds what the log still holds above MARK: 5-9; 1-4 are lost to the stats (5.5's undercount, 4).

name: flush-in-time
note: The orderly end's flush writes the ninth play, which rotates over plays.1.jnl (1-4, saved by nothing). 3 s of the budget left: the rotation's save runs first; none lost.

name: flush-late
note: The orderly end's flush writes the ninth play, which rotates over plays.1.jnl (1-4, saved by nothing). 0.5 s left: no save, and 1-4 are lost to the stats (4).

name: second-player
note: A saves 1-3 (stats.bin generation 1) and plays 4. The card goes into B, which folds A's 4, compacts (no base yet, nothing playing) and saves (generation 2), then plays B 1. Back in A (a remount, its session going on), A plays 5: Hs is refused, the card's stats.bin no longer the copy A's session stands on (5.5). A's next boot reads B's stats.bin and folds B 1 and A 5: every slot once.

name: nvs-back
note: A plays 1-4; a sync's ACKS (4); the boot folds, saves and trims the log empty. NVS is then put back to seq 1 (a settings backup): the seq rule takes ACKS's and MARK's 4, so the next play is 5 (not 2, which ACKS acknowledges and MARK covers: never sent, never folded); the next boot folds it.

name: alternating
note: A and B take the card in turns, each boot folding the other's plays, a sync's ACKS between (A 3, B 2) trimming what the saved MARK covers: each slot once.

name: old-firmware
note: A saves 1-3, plays 4-6 (live, unsaved), then a sync's ACKS (6) and a boot of 0.14.0, which trims both files without folding them. The next stats boot finds ACKS above MARK with 4-6 in no file: HEAD's gap 3, MARK 6 (5.8's undercount, counted).

name: partial-hs
note: partial-tail's card: the boot's scan fails a read after plays.jnl's third slot (9-11 folded, 12-14 not): no save; A then plays 15 and Hs is refused (a partial scan: no save this session). The next boot reads it all: 12-15 folded once, saved.

name: first-at-live
note: first-at-a's seven slots, B's folded at A's boot and A's live (an undated Auto DJ play, then a dated shuffle one, of Harbour Lights; an undated Auto DJ play of Tidewater; a skip of North Pier), saved by a rotation's save (the log's cap 4: plays.1.jnl holds A's first, which no save covers). Their rows are first-at-a's but lastOrd: the live plays' round is HEAD.round + 2, the boot's + 1. The next boot folds the last play.

name: partial-rotation
note: partial-open's card (the stats' MARK 4; plays.1.jnl 1-8, its open failed at this boot; plays.jnl 9-11): no save this session. The second play rotates over plays.1.jnl, 5-8 unsaved: no save is asked (a partial scan), and 5-8 are lost to the stats (4).

name: log-deleted
note: A plays 1-4 and saves them (MARK 4, no sync). plays.jnl is then deleted on a PC and NVS put back to seq 1: with no log and no ACKS, the seq rule's MARK keeps the next play at 5 (2 would be under MARK: never folded).

name: new-epoch-live
note: A plays 1-3, then its NVS is erased: the next boot draws a new epoch, and with no ACKS its scan still reads (0.14.0's didn't): 1-3 fold once under the old epoch's MARK row, and the new epoch's 1 under its own at the boot after.

name: records-save
note: A plays 70: the 64th brings the records to 64, so the records' save runs at the next step, before the 65th's slot, holding 1-64 (stats.bin generation 1); 65-70 are records again, and the next boot folds those 6.

name: records-save-fails
note: A plays 64; the card is full from then on: the records' save is tried before each later play's slot and fails (65-97). 96 brings the records to 96; at 97 the save fails again and the slot has no room: not folded, and the session is behind its log (5.14): no record (98 neither), no save (Hs refused). The next boot folds every one once: 98.

name: records-save-fenced
note: A plays 63; a library update's fence goes up, and 64-66 are written under it: the records' save, due from the 64th, waits for the fence, and Hs is refused under it. It comes down, and the save runs at the next step, before 67's slot, holding 66. The next boot folds 67.

name: records-save-fenced-backlog
note: A plays 64 (the records' save due), and a library update's fence goes up before it runs: the Tracker's backlog and the plays that end under the fence, 65-97 (two of them, 74 and 84, skips), are written under it. 96 brings the records to 96 with the save still waiting: it runs then, whatever the fence, holding 1-96; 97 is a record. Nothing behind; Hs saves 97 after the fence; the next boot folds nothing.

name: records-save-ending
note: A plays 63; the orderly end's flush writes the 64th, then the 65th: the records' save, due from the 64th, is refused while the end flushes (its plays only take records). Nothing is saved; the next boot folds them once: 65.

name: boot-unsaved-70
note: A's 0.14.0 left 70 plays unsynced. The first stats boot folds them (70 records, no overflow) and its save fails; the trim keeps the log. The records' save is due: it runs before the first live slot (71's), holding the 70. The next boot folds 71.

name: records-save-held
note: A saves 1-2 at a boot (generation 1, MARK 2), then plays 3-66; the records' save, before 67's slot, writes stats.tmp whole (generation 2) but replace() fails (stats.bin's remove: it stays generation 1): held. The records are emptied, the card's MARK stays 2. 68-69 are written; Hs promotes the tmp (generation 2) and merges only 67-69 onto it (generation 3). No play counted twice; the next boot folds nothing.

name: held-lost
note: A saves 1-2 at a boot (generation 1, MARK 2), then plays 3-66; the records' save, before 67's slot, writes stats.tmp whole (generation 2) but replace() fails (stats.bin's remove: it stays generation 1): held. The records are emptied, the card's MARK stays 2. 68 is written; the tmp is then removed (a PC, or another player's settle()). Hs finds no tmp and stats.bin the copy before: the session is behind (Hs refused, 69 not folded). The next boot folds 3-69 above MARK 2, once.

name: boot-compaction-held
note: compaction's card (stats.bin's MARK 12 over base stats-00000001.bin of 6 rows; the log 1-16). The boot folds 13-16 and its save compacts: stats-00000002.bin written (base (+) delta), then stats.tmp naming it, whose replace() fails: held (stats.bin still names base 1, which stays). A plays 17-18; Hs promotes the tmp and merges them: stats.bin names base 2, its TRKD 17-18's rows, the old delta in the base. The next boot removes base 1 (named by nothing, beside the named one) and folds nothing.

name: held-promoted-covers
note: The log's cap 4. A plays 1-8 (plays.1.jnl 1-4, plays.jnl 5-8; no stats.bin yet). Hs writes stats.tmp whole, but its rename fails: held (no stats.bin; the card's MARK none). The next Hs promotes it (stats.bin: 1-8, MARK 8) and has nothing more to write. 9 rotates over plays.1.jnl, which the promoted copy's MARK covers: no save asked. The next boot folds 9.

name: records-behind-rotation
note: The log's cap 64. A plays 64; the card is full for 65-97: each records' save fails, and 97 finds the records full: the session is behind. The card mends; 98-128 aren't folded (no record, no save). 129 rotates over plays.1.jnl (1-64, which no save covers): the rotation's save is refused (behind), and 1-64 are lost to the stats (5.14's hole, 64). The next boot folds 65-129.

name: boot-overflow
note: A's 0.14.0 left 300 plays unsynced. The first stats boot folds them, past the records (96): overflow chunks; its save lands at the first try: the overflow given back, nothing behind. A plays 301, Hs saves it, and the next boot folds nothing.

name: boot-overflow-retry
note: A's 0.14.0 left 300 plays unsynced. The first stats boot folds them, past the records (96): overflow chunks; its save fails once and lands at the second try (the boot's waits apart): nothing behind. A plays 301, Hs saves it, and the next boot folds nothing.

name: boot-overflow-unsaved
note: A's 0.14.0 left 300 plays unsynced. The first stats boot folds them, past the records (96): overflow chunks; its save fails at all four tries: the overflow given back, the session behind (301 not folded, Hs refused). The next boot folds them once: 301.

name: boot-overflow-partial
note: The same 300 plays; the card fails a read after the scan's 200th slot: a partial scan, past the records (96), so its overflow goes at once (no save is asked, none tried again) and the session is behind (301 not folded; Hs refused: the partial scan). The next boot reads it all: 301 folded once.

name: boot-overflow-full-rotation
note: A full log (the cap 128: plays.1.jnl 1-128, plays.jnl 129-256), A's 0.14.0's, unsynced. The first stats boot folds the 256 (overflow). Its save fails at all four tries: behind. The first play (257) rotates over plays.1.jnl, which no save covers: the rotation's save is refused, and 1-128 are lost to the stats (5.14's hole, 128). The next boot folds 129-257.

name: boot-overflow-full-rotation-retry
note: A full log (the cap 128: plays.1.jnl 1-128, plays.jnl 129-256), A's 0.14.0's, unsynced. The first stats boot folds the 256 (overflow). Its save fails once and lands at the second try (MARK 256). The first play (257) rotates over plays.1.jnl, which MARK covers: no save asked, none lost. The next boot folds 257.

name: section-damaged
note: The log's cap 4. A plays 1-8; the boot saves them (MARK 8; TRKD 8 rows) and ACKS (4) trims plays.1.jnl (1-4): they are only in stats.bin now. A plays 9; then TRKD's first byte is damaged on the card (its CRC fails, the header unchanged). Hs reads it: the session is behind (Hs refused, 10 not folded). The next boot reads stats.bin Corrupt (stats.bad) and counts from what the log still holds: 5-10; 1-4 are lost to the stats (4).

name: update-nothing
note: A plays 1-3, a library update (its fence over no play), A plays 4-5: the update moves no stats byte (no give-back, no save, no read). Hs saves 1-5; the next boot folds nothing.
